holding_window: Non-resetting 18-hour 20x leveraged position entered at 06:00 UTC (t=360) and held continuously until 24:00 UTC (t=1440), maintenance-margin buffer B_tier = 450 bp ($45,000 per $1M).
motivation: In Part 23 (d4169377), dividing the multiplicative throttle raw_c = raw_b * raw_d by its training mean (~0.686) levered quiet-morning positions up to 1.46x ($1.46M, 29.2x effective leverage), violating the $1M (20x) facility cap during afternoon shocks, and the 21-date sample gave a wide bootstrap CI [-$20.4k, +$1,180.8k] around the +$332.8k (+36.89%) matched-breach capacity gain. Part 24 evaluates (1) the genuine Rule 15c3-5 pre-trade cap q_t in (0, 1] (never leveraging above the $1M 20x limit) and (2) the matched-breach notional capacity across 42 untouched test dates (2nd and 9th of each month in 2025-2026).

primary_1_capped_liq_reduction.criterion: Both point differences < 0 and 95% date-block bootstrap CI upper bounds < 0 (2,000 draws).
primary_1_capped_liq_reduction.estimand: Out-of-sample 18-hour forced-liquidation rate difference LiqRate(raw_c) - LiqRate(raw_b) (and liquidation rate per $1M of deployed notional LiqRate(raw_c)/mean(raw_c) - LiqRate(raw_b)/mean(raw_b)) at B_tier = 450 bp.

primary_2_capped_es95_loss_reduction.criterion: Point difference < 0 and 95% date-block bootstrap CI upper bound < 0 (2,000 draws).
primary_2_capped_es95_loss_reduction.estimand: Out-of-sample 18-hour daily ES95 dollar loss difference ES95(Loss(raw_c)) - ES95(Loss(raw_b)) on the $1M 20x facility.

rules.raw_c_vol_plus_guard: q = min(1.0, k_vol_s / rv_morn) * min(1.0, k_grd_s / (U_cert * S60_up)) in (0, 1]

secondary_matched_breach_capacity_42date: Exact Part 23 matched-breach notional capacity comparison N_bar(c) - N_bar(b) across the 42 untouched test dates.
